## Description {#details}

Type trait utilities and metaprogramming support for the µTest++ testing framework.

The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits">type&#95;traits</a></code> namespace offers a comprehensive suite of type trait templates and metaprogramming utilities employed throughout the µTest++ framework.

This includes templates for function traits, type lists, identity, value wrappers, and compile-time checks for container types, floating point types, and type convertibility. It also provides generic integral and floating point constant wrappers, as well as mechanisms for SFINAE and requirements checking.

These utilities facilitate advanced template programming, type deduction, and compile-time introspection, supporting the flexible and type-safe design of the framework.

All definitions within this namespace are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.

### declval() {#ae488d06debb38c5e638355cb462a1228}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>T &amp;&amp; micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::type&#95;traits::declval (void)</>}>
Utility function template to simulate std::declval for type deduction.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type for which an rvalue reference is required.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Parameters">
None.
</SectionUser>


<SectionUser title="Returns">
An rvalue reference to type <code>T</code>.
</SectionUser>

The <code>declval</code> function template provides a mechanism for obtaining an rvalue reference to a type <code>T</code> without requiring an actual object. This is primarily used in unevaluated contexts, such as within <code>decltype</code>, to deduce types during template metaprogramming in the µTest++ framework.

### is&#95;convertible() {#ae9b4b50700345f54b1c14c594e0637ba}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class From, class To&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>decltype(bool(To(declval&lt; From &gt;()))) micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::type&#95;traits::is&#95;convertible (int n)</>}
  labels = {["constexpr"]}>
Function template to determine if one type is convertible to another.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="From">The source type to be checked for convertibility.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="To">The target type to which conversion is tested.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="n">Dummy parameter used for overload resolution.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Return Values">
<ParametersListItem name="true">if <code>From</code> is convertible to <code>To</code>.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code>is&#95;convertible</code> function template checks, at compile time, whether a value of type <code>From</code> can be implicitly converted to type <code>To</code>. This is achieved using SFINAE and is primarily used as an implementation detail for the <code>is&#95;convertible&#95;v</code> variable template within the µTest++ framework.

If the conversion is valid, this overload is selected and returns <code>true</code>.
